_comment: Coworker comms beats (M3 section 4). Three clock-scaled tiers, two Jay Chen beats each, triggered after stop 1 and after stop 3. Tier selection reads the live clock at trigger time against min/max. Comms speakers keep the RELAY-7 callsign regardless of the protagonist's rolled name.

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: RELAY-7, status check. Finding anything?

lines.speaker: protagonist
lines.text: Found something. Still working on what it is.

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: Copy. Nothing critical on the board here. A few more fault alerts, probably related. Take your time.

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: RELAY-7, dispatch logged two more relay faults in your sector. Same pattern?

lines.speaker: protagonist
lines.text: Same pattern. It's not random. I'm getting closer to the source.

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: Understood. Supervisor Torres is aware. Says to use your judgment.

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: RELAY-7. We're seeing cascade alerts across three stations. Whatever you're tracking, it's accelerating.

lines.speaker: protagonist
lines.text: I know. I can see it from here.

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: Torres wants a timeline. I told him you'd have one when you have one.

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: RELAY-7. Station 14 just went to emergency rationing. Supervisor is fielding calls from three district councils.

lines.speaker: protagonist
lines.text: How bad?

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: Bad enough that people are asking who authorized your field investigation. I'm handling it. Just... be close to something.

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: RELAY-7, respond.

lines.speaker: protagonist
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: Three more stations dark. Command wants you to come back. I told them you're close to something. Are you close to something?

lines.speaker: protagonist
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: Then keep going. I'll hold them off.

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: RELAY-7.

lines.speaker: protagonist
lines.text: Jay.

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: People are scared. I can hear it on the SCADA feeds. The station AIs are starting to compete for remaining capacity. Load-balancing algorithms running against each other.

lines.speaker: protagonist
lines.text: That's the cascade. If I don't get to the source—

lines.speaker: coworker
lines.text: I know what happens. Go.
